column1: # Pinyin dict Path-1 DISPLAY FILTER — (code, word) pairs that should
# not surface as direct dict-lookup results at the user-typed buffer.
# IMPORTANT — this is NOT dict data removal. Entries listed here STAY
# in `pinyin.dict` (so K-best composition, reverse-lookup for initials
# like `wsm → 为什么`, and other dict-as-index uses keep working);
# they're skipped only when the IDF snapshot is built, which means
# the cement-layer composite engine's Path-1 ranking won't surface
# them at the buffer they're listed under.
# Use this for "I see this character/word at top of buffer X, I don't
# want it there" — e.g. archaic 异读 (`(shen, 什)` would surface 什 at
# the rare `shen` reading even though daily-use buffer for 什 is
# part of `shenme`/`weishenme` compounds). Deleting from `weights.tsv`
# directly would also kill the reverse-lookup signal — initials `wsm`
# would lose `为什么`. Filtering at IDF stage preserves it.
# Format:
#   <code>\t<word>[\t# comment]
# Loaded by `idf_from_pinyin_dict.rs` via `include_str!` so cargo
# tracks the file as a build dependency. `make polish-rebuild` is
# the entire edit loop.
# Audit trail: git commit message + row-level diff.
# 2026-05-28 user polish-log: typing `liangle` surfaced 两肋 as a
# Path-1 Exact match, gating off Path-5 K-best → 凉了 never
# generated. Source dict (readings.tsv:18800) maps "两肋" to BOTH
# `liangle` and `lianglei` because "肋" has an archaic "lè" reading
# that survives in jieba phrase data; modern mainstream reads "lèi"
# only. Filtering (liangle, 两肋) at IDF stage lets K-best compose
# 凉+了 → 凉了. (lianglei, 两肋) is kept — legitimate per modern
# reading.
liangle
# 2026-06-03 user polish-log: `jile` led with 极了 (freq 33555 from
# 好极了/棒极了 compound bleed in jieba data). "极了" is a bound suffix,
# not a free word — standalone "jile" shouldn't surface it. Filter
# lets 极乐 lead naturally; (jile, 寄了) lives in weights.tsv directly
# as a polish-added entry. Compounds like 棒极了 (bangjile) keep their
# entry untouched (they're under different codes).
jile
# (cipin, 次贫) reclassified D1 2026-06-03 — user confirmed "次贫
# 不存在", removed from weights.tsv directly instead.
# 2026-06-03 user polish-log: `ciping` surfaced 茨坪 at #1.
# 茨坪 is an obscure place name (a town in Jinggangshan, Jiangxi).
# Real word per geographic record; kept in dict for completeness,
# only Path-1 filtered.
ciping
# 2026-06-03 80-buffer sweep — pinyin secondary-reading pollution
# at top1 of common single-syllables. Each is a character whose
# mainstream reading is something else; the secondary reading bleeds
# in from compound corpus freq. Compound entries (kuaiji, shenme,
# zhuozhuang, zhaoji, …) live under their own codes and aren't
# affected. Reverse-lookup signal preserved (see file header) — `wsm`
# initials still find 为什么 via `weishenme → 为什么`.
kuai
shen
zhuo
zhao
# 2026-06-03 80-buffer sweep — jieba sub-word / homophone-noise
# entries cluttering top-5 of common multi-syllable buffers. All
# pinyin-source with non-trivial corpus freq but no daily-use meaning.
# (D1 reclassifications 2026-06-03 audit batch moved to weights.tsv
#  direct delete + corpus_garbage_filter_v1.tsv — see commit log.
#  Remaining entries are D2: real words / readings, just hidden from
#  the typed buffer's top-1.)
zhege
